listAppointmentsByDateRange.description:
List appointments (all patients) by date range Returns appointments whose **event.from** or **event.to** intersects the [from, to) window.
Use this to report on the diary across **all patients**.
. Read only; restricted to this practice. Results may be partial; never infer a population total. Pagination totals describe the page, not the whole result set. Prefer the diary tools for complete daily reports.
